notes.title: Minor Bugfix Update
notes.content:
A minor bugfix update has been released, see the issues that have been fixed below.
[list]
[*]Fixed a circumstance in which you would fail when turning away from an edge while very close to that edge (this occurred most frequently on the Triangle level, but applies to all levels).
[*]The tutorial completion progress to the next level indicator will no longer mistakenly report 100% completion when you have not in fact completed it.
[*]Spam clicking on the play button for a level (clicking it in two or more consecutive frames in a row) no longer results in game getting stuck and fading to dark grey.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v1.2
notes.content:
[h1]Update v1.2 is now Live![/h1]

This update adds 4 new levels and is available free to all owners of Roundabout 3 on Steam.

The new levels added in this update are:
[list]
[*]Right Triangle, a classic-style level, similar to the ones already in the game.
[*]Dot, a new level with a twist (or perhaps a pivot?). Swing from dot to dot, you're also awarded extra points for your precision.
[*]Line, a curvy new level with a unique playstyle & animation.
[*]Endless Square, a different kind of level that is not only endless as it's name suggests (I can't wait to see those high scores!), it progresses differently every time you play it.
[/list]

This update is available free to everyone who owns Roundabout 3 on Steam... You can find the new level category, Bonus Level Pack 2, on the level select screen after completing the tutorial. 

The soundtrack has also been updated with the new tracks added with this release.

notes.title: Update v1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Update v1.1 is now released![/h1]
This update adds three new levels to master with nearly 15 minutes of new music: [b]Rhombus[/b], [b]Spiral[/b], and [b]Circle[/b].

The update is available free to everyone who owns Roundabout 3... So hop right in and get those high scores! You can find the new level category, Bonus Level Pack 1, on the level select screen after completing the tutorial. The soundtrack has also been updated with the new tracks added with this release.
